description: Create a one-time web page where the user drops a 3D file you cannot pass to this server, such as a chat attachment or a file on their phone. Use it only when the file has no public URL and you cannot read the user's disk; with a public URL, upload_scene is faster. Parameters: set `as` if the user said what the file is ('product' for one object; 'interior', 'building' or 'exterior' for walkable scenes) so Verse skips guessing; `name` pre-fills the scene id, which the user can still change on the page. Give the user the link and the returned instructions, wait until they say it is uploaded, then call get_upload_link_status. Each link accepts one file, expires after 30 minutes, and uploads into the user's own account with their plan's file-size cap (1 GB free, up to 20 GB paid). Up to 60 links an hour per account. Requires sign-in (connector sign-in, or VERSE_API_KEY for the local server).

as.description: What the file is, if the user said: a 'product' (a single object) or a walkable 'interior'/'building'/'exterior'.

name.description: Optional slug for the scene id, lowercase letters, digits, - and _ (the user can change it on the page).

name: create_upload_link

instructions.description: Text to show the user with the link.

link.description: The one-time upload page to give the user.

singleUse.description: Always true: the link accepts one upload.

title: Create an upload link for a file the user has
